actions.MAIN: input gate: 1 = new peaks accepted (default), 0 = hold what is frozen
actions.CLEAR: drop all frozen bins, accumulate again
actions.HOLD: value>0.5 latches hold on, else off

ops_per_sample: hand count, N=1024 hop 256: 1 fwd + 1 inverse FFT (~46k) + unpack/pack/post ~35k + per-bin 513 x ~50 (hill-climb rotation, peak test, phasor step, cutoffs/tilt) ~26k = ~107k/256 = ~420 flops/sample. Host measured ~43 ns/sample.
memory_bytes: 14 x 1025 floats + 1 STFT (1 synthesis channel) ~ 90 KB at N up to 2048
notes: Rebuilt 2026-11-16 from the author's description: per-bin time-peak detector (local max over 3 frames), hold until a larger peak (above THRESH when USETHR), FREEZE factor decays held bins (100% = none), coherent phase advance from analysis, unfrozen bins pass live (zeroed under threshold with ZEROBIN), BRIGHT tilt, LOCUT/HICUT, RNDPHASE, output limiter >0.8. Guessed: decay law, units, tilt, random-phase law, live pass-through, stereo (mono wet). MIX crossfade, MIX=0 = undelayed dry. Wet latency N+N/4-1.
params: MIX FREEZE(Freeze Factor %) USETHR THRESH ZEROBIN BRIGHT LOCUT HICUT RNDPHASE GAIN FRAME(FFT size). Names/behaviour follow Michael Norris's Spectral Freezing guide (michaelnorris.info/software/soundmagic-spectral/guide/). Feedback not implemented.
